recommendation: Keep the source fix as-is; it is a narrow correction to active DocumentReference source that aligns with the Applied disposition without changing broader behavior or generated diagrams.
issue_request: Applied/Persuasive with Modification R6 DocumentReference issue requesting clearer separation between relatesTo lifecycle links and related non-lifecycle associations, conversion of related to a code-plus-target backbone, a relatedArtifactType subset binding, and updated search handling.
initial_application: FHIR-53824 had already been mostly applied through commits 3800384a0c, 27bd95ec53, and 092a94f821, which converted related to a BackboneElement, added code and target, added notes, corrected the binding URL, removed an erroneous relatesTo modifier comment, and added the document-related-artifact-type value set.
additional_context: FHIR-53550 is the same change family and says FHIR-53824 fulfills its request for a coded related structure. Zulip and OO minutes confirm the concern was missing relationship semantics for a flexible Reference(Any), not a document-only target. Current source still had stale document-to-document wording in related.code binding text and related.target definition.
reconciliation: Updated source/documentreference/structuredefinition-DocumentReference.xml so related.code describes the relationship between the document reference and related resource, and related.target is defined as the reference to the related resource. Updated source/documentreference/valueset-document-related-artifact-type.xml to remove trailing spaces from the AssociatedReferenceType name/title.
source_changes: source/documentreference/structuredefinition-DocumentReference.xml: corrected DocumentReference.related.code binding description and DocumentReference.related.target definition to refer to related resources rather than documents.
source/documentreference/valueset-document-related-artifact-type.xml: removed trailing spaces from the AssociatedReferenceType name and title metadata.
